game_concept: A puzzle set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Priority Alert: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Terrace, repeat each round: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the alert_accuracy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the treasure chest using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The treasure chest reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the treasure chest is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Priority Alert
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Priority Alert' (Week 3 slot 13), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert_accuracy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Tavern Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The treasure chest reached with actions_used <= 13.
